instruction: Speak in German. Deliver this line at a very fast pace, almost breathlessly.
text: Die Abfahrt des Zuges nach Hamburg verzögert sich um wenige Minuten auf Gleis vier.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speech is delivered at an extremely fast pace as requested, but it sounds artificially time-compressed rather than naturally breathless.

instruction_evidence.speed: The pace is exceptionally fast, clearly fulfilling the speed requirement of the instruction.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds robotic and artificially sped up, losing human-like articulation.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is flat and mechanical, lacking the expressive nuance of true breathlessness.
